entities.title: Render the contact sheet
entities.summary: Every sample screen as one PNG, to review the look after a change to a painter, the text or the art.
entities.when: After changing anything in src/ui/ or src/zx/ that changes what a screen looks like.
steps: For only some screens: node build.mjs --test, then node dist-test/scripts/contact-sheet.mjs <out.png> <pattern>; SHEET_PAIRS sets how many screens a row holds (3 by default)
entities.verify: The PNG shows every sample with its name, FLASH off and on; npm test's layout tests pass for the same samples.
